digest.component_or_area: plan-review model ladder and context-limit escalation
propositions: Sonnet 4.6 and Opus 4.8 declare identical 1,000,000-token context windows in MODEL_LADDER, so escalation from sonnet to opus gains zero additional capacity and guarantees a re-failure at higher cost.

Context-limit retry loops consume models_at_or_above(), which returns both sonnet and opus rungs, causing a silent self-confirming no-op escalation that masks the true defect (identical windows) as a misleading diagnosis (even opus cannot fit it).

A new escalation_rungs() function must filter models_at_or_above() to remove any rung whose declared window is not strictly greater than the last kept rung, ensuring every escalation step represents a real capacity increase.

Both context-limit escalation loops (pass1_with_ladder and run_focused_finder) must consume escalation_rungs() instead of models_at_or_above() to prevent the no-op paid call to opus after a sonnet context-limit failure.
Window figures (200k haiku, 1M sonnet, 1M opus) are correct per live Models API max_input_tokens verification, so the defect is in consumption, not in the table itself.
